_comment: Allowlist of scripts/check-pages.mjs. Every entry names the file, the exact exported functions it covers ("default" for the default export) and a written reason. Only doors that are public by design belong here: none of them reads data of a restaurant chosen by the caller. A stale entry (file gone, function gone, function passes without it) fails the check.

entries.reason: Root layout of the whole dashboard, also of the public sign-in and invitation pages: reads only the language (getI18n), no restaurant data.
/admin reads only the caller's own session (getPrincipal) and redirects to the caller's own restaurant or to sign-in; no slug, no restaurant data.
The sign-in page is public by design: it reads only the caller's own session (getPrincipal) to send a signed-in person on; no slug, no restaurant data.
A17 accept-invitation page is public by design (spec E12 F2): the token is the credential, the restaurant comes from the token's row, a dead token shows the same page.

Accepting an invitation is public by design (spec E12 F2): the token is the credential and InvitationService.accept checks it (unknown, used, revoked, expired, other e-mail) before anything is written.
Sign-in has no session yet (the password is the check); sign-out only ends the caller's own session from its own cookie. Neither takes a slug.
The language switch only sets the wm_lang cookie and redirects to a validated dashboard path; it reads and writes no data and needs no session.
